risks.title: Inability to repay debt at maturity
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions the need to secure additional financing to repay the $800 million convertible notes maturing in 2027. Failure to obtain this financing is presented as a major risk. This risk is weighted by its existential nature for the company's going concern

risks.title: Debt covenant risk
risks.score_rationale: The senior credit agreement imposes strict financial covenants, restrictions on dividends, indebtedness, and acquisitions. Although the company is in compliance, future non-compliance with these covenants, particularly the minimum liquidity covenant, could trigger restrictive clauses. This risk is assessed as high due to its potential impact on financial flexibility

risks.title: Interest rate volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company has $40 million of variable-rate debt. A 1% increase in interest rates would result in an additional $0.4 million in interest expenses. While the impact is moderate, it represents a recurring financial risk. This risk is classified as medium due to its direct but limited financial impact

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on international sales
risks.score_rationale: Approximately 44% of sales are generated internationally in various currencies. Fluctuations in exchange rates can affect financial results. The company uses hedging instruments, but residual risk remains. This risk is assessed as medium, as it affects a significant portion of revenues

risks.title: Share repurchase program and dividend suspension
risks.score_rationale: The company has an active share repurchase program and has suspended dividends. While this may support the stock price, it reduces cash available for other uses and may be perceived negatively by certain investors. This risk is considered minor to medium, as it is a strategic decision

risks.title: Increase in capital expenditures
risks.score_rationale: The company expects an increase in capital expenditures in 2026 compared to 2025. Although funded by operating cash flows, these higher expenditures require careful management. This risk is assessed as minor to medium, as it relates to strategic investments

ai_positioning.summary: CNMD does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing
